name: Teen Summer Volunteer Program, St. David's North Austin Medical Center
org: St. David's HealthCare, North Austin Medical Center
what_you_do: Volunteer at a hospital for the summer. After you apply, you send more paperwork. If you are picked, you interview, finish screenings and go to orientation.
who_can_apply: High school students ages 16 to 18. You must be 16 by June 1 and available the whole program.
duration: 7 to 8 weeks, usually first week of June to end of July. Weekly hours are not stated.
deadline_text: The page says applications run March 1 to March 31 and late materials are not accepted. The year is not stated.
how_to_apply: Send the online application. Then you get an email asking for a teen and parent agreement, two letters of support, short essay answers and shot records. Teens who are picked get an invite to interview. Orientation is by invite. Email namc.volunteers@hcahealthcare.com or call 512-901-1223.
notes: St. David's Medical Center in central Austin has a separate teen program with different ages (15 to 18) and dates. Apply to the campus whose rules you meet.
